experimental_question: For eligible consenting visitors after release gates, does optional original video improve verified outbound product-link interest relative to identical text-only source guide?
method: Only after approval use first-party non-identifying counters, no cookies, fingerprinting, localStorage, user IDs or raw IP/referrer logging; randomized session assignment would require separate reviewed privacy architecture.
estimand: approved affiliate outbound clicks / eligible page presentations (not purchases); compare uncertainty intervals with small samples; no statistical claims until adequate sample/analysis design.
safety: No consent bypass, no external scripts, no conversion pixels, no production endpoint configured. Existing Focus/Jetpack analytics remain unchanged.
